t: The Swirl Caldew bathroom towel ring offers a practical and hygienic solution for towel storage in various settings. Constructed from durable stainless steel, this chrome-plated towel holder resists moisture, rust, and mould, ensuring long-term performance and easy cleaning. It is ideal for busy bathrooms, en-suites, or washrooms where durability and cleanliness are paramount. Installation is versatile, allowing wall-mounting with screws for a secure 4kg capacity or with 3M adhesive for up to 2kg. All necessary fixings are supplied, and concealed fixings provide a neat, professional finish.
